candidates.title: A Strategic Framework for Ukraine's Scientific Recovery - Video on the Gdańsk Declaration and the Road Ahead - ALLEA
candidates.summary: Reviewing the Gdańsk Declaration The Gdańsk meeting brought together representatives of 35 member organisations, including national ministries, the European Commission, UNESCO, and research funding and performing organisations, to establish a shared strategic framework for supporting Ukraine’s science, research, and innovation ecosystem. ALLEA, along with the European Commission, has published a new video on the strategic directions for science, research, and innovation as part of Ukraine’s recovery based on the outcomes of the first High-Level Steering Committee Meeting of the International Coalition for Science, Research and Innovation in Ukraine. September 2026 ALLEA has released a new video alongside the European Commission and other partners that highlights the strategic priorities for science, research, and innovation in Ukraine’s recovery.
candidates.core_message: Shalini Randeria for a wide-ranging conversation on "What does scientific freedom actually protect.
